text:
sam: Heads up — planning post-merge publish for py/ts SDKs in the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window tonight. Need final signoff on signer rotations and the deprecation blurb for legacy sync client. Deploy bot will run preflight at 01:45 UTC. Link: https://go.redwood/release/PR-789

maria: lgtm on deprecation text, pushed minor wording to PR

katie: seen a minor wheel checksum flake in staging earlier today — I re-ran `pip wheel` build, logs attached. recommend we hold off if the deploy bot flags checksum mismatch

rajesh: +1 to hold if checksum fails. also remind: npm packages use `npm dist-tag` after publish for canaries

deploy-bot: preflight checks queued for 2476000520

deploy-bot: preflight result: staging smoke ok; wheel checksum ok; npm tarball integrity ok

sam: good. will start publish at 02:05 UTC. plan: publish py first, then npm, then tag `latest` after 5m. rollback plan: yank py wheel and republish previous wheel + yank npm tag

katie: add note to release-notes: "sync client will be deprecated in 2.0, please migrate to async" — done

maria: double-check that docs redirect for sync client is in next PR

release-notes-bot: release notes draft created: https://go.redwood/release-notes/789

rajesh: quick reminder — for private deployments we need to add the signer key rotation step to the ops runbook

sam: adding runbook snippet:
```
# for signer rotation
- stop publisher
- backup keys
- run `redwoodctl signer rotate --pkg py-sdk`
- validate artifacts signatures
- resume publisher
```

katie: sounds good. I will be on-call during the window, ping me right before publish :phone

sam: starting publish now

deploy-bot: publish started 2476001187

deploy-bot: py wheel published: py-sdk-1.9.0 (sha256:abc123) — npm package published: @redwood/sdk-js v1.9.0 (tgz sha1:def456)

maria: ran quick smoke tests — embeddings & chat route ok

katie: npm install looks good in staging app

rajesh: prod rollout gating: will wait 7m, then tag `latest` if no regressions

sam: tagging `latest` now

deploy-bot: tag applied: npm dist-tag @redwood/sdk-js@1.9.0 latest

release-notes-bot: published release notes

katie: noticed a rare TypeError in logging when using `syncClient.close()` — not in main flows. opened issue #1022

sam: ok, rollforward — we won't revert. add a hotfix ticket for 1.9.1. set patch cutoff next Tuesday

maria: ack. updating changelog and deprecation notice expiry dates

sam: thanks everyone. closing thread. :tada:
